desviarAoArrastar.Name: Route around walls when dragging
desviarAoArrastar.Hint: When dragging a token, the path goes around walls, closed doors and impassable terrain instead of stopping at the wall. Applies to everyone.

mostrarAlcance.Name: Highlight turn reach
mostrarAlcance.Hint: When a token is selected, highlights the spaces it can reach with the movement left this turn.

mostrarDobro.Name: Also show double move (Dash)
mostrarDobro.Hint: Highlights in a lighter tone the spaces the token can reach spending double its speed.

corAlcance.Name: Reach color
corAlcance.Hint: Color of the highlighted spaces, in hex (e.g. #3fa7ff).

mostrarRestante.Name: Show movement left on the ruler
mostrarRestante.Hint: While dragging a token, the last ruler point shows how much movement is left this turn (e.g. "15 ft left").

colorirRegua.Name: Red ruler past speed
colorirRegua.Hint: Colors red the part of the ruler beyond the token's speed. D&D 5e already does this, so the option is ignored there.

atributoDeslocamento.Name: Speed attribute
atributoDeslocamento.Hint: Path to the speed on the actor (e.g. system.attributes.speed.value). Blank: automatic in D&D 5e.

deslocamentoPadrao.Name: Default speed
deslocamentoPadrao.Hint: Used when the actor has no speed. 0 turns off reach and "left" for those tokens.

npcLimitarTurno.Name: Auto path stops at end of turn
npcLimitarTurno.Hint: In combat, a token walking on its own stops when it runs out of movement for the turn.

npcEvitarTokens.Name: Auto path avoids tokens
npcEvitarTokens.Hint: A token walking on its own does not pass through spaces occupied by other tokens.

moverAteCursor.Name: Walk to cursor
moverAteCursor.Hint: GM: selected tokens walk on their own to the point under the cursor, along the best path.

alternarAlcance.Name: Toggle reach highlight
alternarAlcance.Hint: Hides or shows the turn reach highlight.

Npc.SemToken: Select a token to walk to the cursor.
Npc.SemCaminho: {nome} has no path to that point.
Npc.SemMovimento: {nome} has used all movement this turn.
Npc.GradeNaoSuportada: {nome}: auto path only works on square grids with whole-size tokens.

acoes.label: Blocks
acoes.hint: Movement types that cannot pass. Blank: blocks all. E.g. tick only Walk for a chasm that flyers can cross.
